title: CAR: Query-Guided Confidence-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Zhipeng Song; Yizhi Zhou; Xiangyu Kong; Jiulong Jiao; Xuezhou Ye; Chunqi Gao; Xueqing Shi; Yuhang Zhou; Heng Qi
why_relevant: CAR uses generator confidence (semantic consistency of sampled answers) to rerank documents, filtering noisy/unhelpful evidence and gating intervention based on query-level uncertainty—directly addressing calibration-aware control over retrieval and mitigating noisy retrieval in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on reranking; doesn't address adversarial or conflict cases.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control / Filtering Noisy Retrieval
